_comment: THE stage manifest. What steps an operation has, in what order, and how long each one took the
last time it was measured. Read by bash with jq and by ctl.py with json — the same bytes, for
exactly the reason lessons.json gives for existing: a generated second copy is how two readers
come to disagree, and a stage list that disagrees with the script is worse than no stage list,
because it reports progress against steps that are not the ones running.
`expect_s` is MEASURED, never estimated. Every value for openshift-sno comes from the timeline in
openshift-sno/REPRODUCE.md section 7 (the 2026-08-10 run that produced a working cluster), and the
lesson values from chapter 1-3 runs on 2026-08-06 and 2026-08-08. They exist so a wait can say
'4m of an expected 7m' instead of going silent, which is the difference between a slow step and a
hung one. They are a starting point, not the truth: ctl.py overrides any of them from the most
recent SUCCESSFUL run recorded in .state/, so the numbers self-calibrate when the hardware moves.
A stage id is a resume point. `install.sh --from <id>` and `ctl.py up --from <id>` both take these
names, so renaming one is a breaking change to a documented interface — REPRODUCE.md section 7
prints `./install.sh --from api` as the recovery move. install.sh READS the openshift-sno ids from
here rather than keeping its own copy, so the order below is the order it runs: it kept a second
list once, the two drifted by one stage (`preflight`), and the cost was a watcher permanently
stuck at 9/10 plus a `--from preflight` that ran nothing and reported success.
`billable` marks the stages that cost money. Everything before the first billable stage is free,
which is the whole design of preflight: find out for EUR 0 rather than with a box already running.
Lesson substrate stages are NOT listed here. They come from lessons.json, per lesson, because that
file is the only per-lesson table; `substrate_expect_s` below carries only the duration hint for
each substrate script, keyed by the same name lessons.json uses.

stages.title: Preflight
stages.detail: release pin, artifacts, metal stock, credentials, lesson-13 deps

stages.title: Provision the box
stages.detail: scw orders EM-B112X-SSD, Scaleway installs Ubuntu, then sshd settles

stages.title: Capture facts
stages.detail: machineNetwork CIDR and the install disk's WWN, read off the box

stages.title: Generate ignition
stages.detail: install-config, single-node ignition, disk-wipe unit, arm64 wrap

stages.title: kexec into RHCOS live
stages.detail: push the 109 KB ignition and jump; the box is RHCOS in RAM afterwards
//rewrites_box: The one stage that cannot be re-run against a cluster you want to keep: it replaces the
operating system and the ignition wipes every disk first. A resume from HERE, or from any
stage before it, therefore destroys a working cluster on its way past — which is why the
panel asks a different question before starting one. Read as data, not prose: the flag is
what the confirmation is computed from, so it must stay on whichever stage that is true of.

stages.title: Bootstrap and roll out
stages.detail: bootkube, install-to-disk, pivot reboot, node registers, trimmed operator set
//substages: An hour in one row is not progress, so this stage reports the three phases it can actually
OBSERVE — no more. Each boundary below is a state change the wait loop already reads, which
is the whole test for whether a substage may exist: install-to-disk and the pivot reboot are
one interval here and not two, because from the workstation they are indistinguishable (the
box is simply not answering, then a node appears). Inventing the split would report a
The three expect_s sum to the parent's 3720. They come from the same REPRODUCE.md section 7
timeline: 09:02->09:09 bootkube, 09:09->09:46 install-to-disk + pivot + the node registering,
09:46->10:04 operators. The middle one is inflated: that run hit the api-int DNS deadlock of
section 8, which node_dns now repairs, so expect it to fall to roughly a third once a clean

substages.title: Bootstrap control plane
substages.detail: a throwaway control plane runs from RAM until /opt/openshift/.bootkube.done

substages.title: Install to disk, pivot, register
substages.detail: the permanent system is written, the box reboots into it, the kubelet joins — where the api-int deadlock lives

substages.title: Operators roll out
substages.detail: the trimmed operator set reconciles on one node; the *.apps-blocked pair never will

stages.title: Pre-provision storage
stages.detail: hostPath PVs labelled container_file_t — SNO ships no StorageClass

stages.title: Sandboxed containers + Kata
stages.detail: OSC operator, then KataConfig — no reboot: the extension is a day-1 manifest

stages.title: OpenShell gateway
stages.detail: privileged SCC for the sandbox SA, then the pinned 0.0.99 chart

stages.title: Verify from inside
stages.detail: Kata pod reports DMI=KVM, SCC refuses a privileged pod, gateway Running

stages.title: Provision the box
stages.detail: Terraform apply for the whole claimed set, then this lesson's state file

stages.title: Wait for ssh
stages.detail: two consecutive successes — sshd flaps during first boot

stages.title: Wait for cloud-init
stages.detail: it creates the unprivileged agent user and enables lingering

stages.title: Copy the repo
stages.detail: bootstrap rsync over plain ssh, then mirror the tree

stages.title: Install uv
stages.detail: curl, ca-certificates, jq, then the uv installer

stages.title: Install substrates
stages.detail: expanded per lesson from lessons.json; see substrate_expect_s

stages.title: Assert the boundary
stages.detail: check.sh, read from inside the box and never from the flag we passed

stages.title: Wait for the box
stages.detail: instant on a ready box; otherwise polls until up.sh finishes provisioning it

stages.title: Sync the lesson tree
stages.detail: rsync the repo to the box; results/ is excluded in both directions

stages.title: Run the lesson
stages.detail: uv sync then main.py, on the box, where the boundary is

stages.title: Fetch the scorecard
stages.detail: bring results/<lesson>.json home and render the report

stages.title: Destroy the box
stages.detail: Terraform re-apply with this lesson subtracted

stages.title: Sweep for orphans
stages.detail: ask the ACCOUNT, not the script: servers, volumes and IPs all bill on their own
